name: DatePicker
description: Selects a date or date range from a calendar.

dependencies.name: react-day-picker
dependencies.reason: Optional — renders the calendar popup; the trigger and form field work without it.

selected.description: Controlled date (single mode). Type: Date | null

selectedRange.description: Controlled range (range mode). Type: DateRange | null

onSelect.description: Called when a single date is selected

onChange.description: Alias for onSelect (consistent with Input/Select onChange convention)

onRangeSelect.description: Called when a date range is selected

label.description: Visible label text above the date picker

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the date picker

error.description: Show error styling. When a string is provided, it is displayed as an error message.

when: A date the user picks off a calendar
A start and end date together
whenNot: Time on its own (use a dedicated TimePicker)
A handful of known dates (use Select)
Typed date entry (use Input with a date mask)
guidelines: Pair range mode with numberOfMonths={2} so both ends are visible
size="sm" lines the trigger up with other dense toolbar controls
Offer presets for the common ranges: Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days
disabledDates blocks past or unavailable days before the user tries
Placeholder names the date, not the action
DatePicker.Trigger defaults to type="button", so it is safe inside a form
accessibility: The calendar grid is fully keyboard navigable
Focus returns to the trigger on close

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Trigger opens one month; today is outlined.

examples.name: Small Trigger
examples.description: Matches the height of other sm toolbar controls.

examples.name: Date Range
examples.description: Two months side by side so both ends of the range are visible.

examples.name: Multi-Month
examples.description: Three months at once, for dates far from today.

examples.name: Disabled Dates
examples.description: Everything before today is greyed out and unclickable.
examples.code:
<StatefulDatePicker
  placeholder="Select a future date"
  disabledDates={{ before: new Date() }}
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</StatefulDatePicker>

examples.name: With Presets
examples.description: Shortcut buttons beside the calendar skip the common ranges.
examples.code: Today Last 7 days Last 30 days Last 90 days

examples.name: With Label and Helper Text
examples.description: Label above the trigger, supporting text below it.
examples.code:
<StatefulDatePicker
  label="Renewal date"
  placeholder="Pick a date"
  helperText="Billing restarts on this day each month."
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</StatefulDatePicker>

examples.name: Error State
examples.description: Red border on the trigger, and the reason below it.
examples.code:
<DatePicker
  label="Start Date"
  placeholder="Pick a date"
  error="Please select a start date"
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed; the calendar will not open.

relations.note: Use Select for choosing from a list of options
Use Input for free-form text date entry
DatePicker uses Popover for the calendar dropdown

propsSummary: helperText: string - helper text below field
error: boolean | string - error styling and message
DatePicker.Trigger: button props supported (type defaults to "button")

commonPatterns: <DatePicker size="sm" selected={date} onSelect={setDate}><DatePicker.Trigger placeholder="Pick a date" /><DatePicker.Content><DatePicker.Calendar /></DatePicker.Content></DatePicker>
